DECL Shao.OQ3.uniform_standardized_pair_quartic_log_remainder
TYPE ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (law : ι → MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)),
  (∀ (i : ι), MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (law i)) →
    (∀ (i : ι) (j : Fin 2), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => y j) 2 (law i)) →
      (∀ (i : ι) (j : Fin 2), ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), y j ∂law i = 0) →
        (∀ (i : ι) (j k : Fin 2),
            ProbabilityTheory.covariance (fun y => y j) (fun y => y k) (law i) = if j = k then 1 else 0) →
          ∀ (M3 M4 M5 : ℝ),
            (∀ (i : ι), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ 3) (law i)) →
              (∀ (i : ι), ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ 3 ∂law i ≤ M3) →
                (∀ (i : ι), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ 4) (law i)) →
                  (∀ (i : ι), ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ 4 ∂law i ≤ M4) →
                    (∀ (i : ι), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ 5) (law i)) →
                      (∀ (i : ι), ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ 5 ∂law i ≤ M5) →
                        have Phi := fun i u v =>
                          ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), Complex.exp (↑(u * y 0 + v * y 1) * Complex.I) ∂law i;
                        have Q := fun i u v =>
                          -↑(u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2 - Complex.I * ↑(∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), (u * y 0 + v * y 1) ^ 3 ∂law i) / 6 +
                            ↑(∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), (u * y 0 + v * y 1) ^ 4 ∂law i - 3 * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) ^ 2) / 24;
                        ∃ C delta,
                          0 < C ∧
                            0 < delta ∧
                              delta ≤ 1 ∧
                                ∀ (i : ι) (u v : ℝ),
                                  √(u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) ≤ delta →
                                    ‖Complex.log (Phi i u v) - Q i u v‖ ≤ C * √(u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) ^ 5
AXIOMS [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
KIND theorem

DECL Shao.OQ3.uniform_standardized_pair_log_moment_approximation
TYPE ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (law : ι → MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)),
  (∀ (i : ι), MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (law i)) →
    (∀ (i : ι) (j : Fin 2), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => y j) 2 (law i)) →
      (∀ (i : ι) (j : Fin 2), ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), y j ∂law i = 0) →
        (∀ (i : ι) (j k : Fin 2),
            ProbabilityTheory.covariance (fun y => y j) (fun y => y k) (law i) = if j = k then 1 else 0) →
          ∀ (m : ℕ),
            1 ≤ m →
              ∀ (M3 Mm : ℝ),
                (∀ (i : ι), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ 3) (law i)) →
                  (∀ (i : ι), ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ 3 ∂law i ≤ M3) →
                    (∀ (i : ι), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ m) (law i)) →
                      (∀ (i : ι), ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ m ∂law i ≤ Mm) →
                        have Phi := fun i u v =>
                          ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), Complex.exp (↑(u * y 0 + v * y 1) * Complex.I) ∂law i;
                        have P := fun i u v =>
                          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m,
                            Complex.I ^ j / ↑j.factorial * ↑(∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), (u * y 0 + v * y 1) ^ j ∂law i);
                        have K2 := 2 + (Real.exp 1 + 4) * |M3|;
                        have Km := 1 + (Real.exp 1 + ↑m + 1) * |Mm|;
                        0 < K2 ∧
                          0 < Km ∧
                            ∃ delta,
                              0 < delta ∧
                                delta ≤ 1 ∧
                                  ∀ (i : ι) (u v : ℝ),
                                    √(u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) ≤ delta →
                                      ‖Phi i u v - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
                                        ‖P i u v - 1‖ ≤ 1 ∧
                                          ∀ (q : ℕ),
                                            ‖Complex.log (Phi i u v) - Complex.logTaylor (q + 1) (P i u v - 1)‖ ≤
                                              2 * (K2 * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2)) ^ (q + 1) / ↑(q + 1) +
                                                ↑(q + 1) * Km * √(u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) ^ m
AXIOMS [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
KIND theorem
DECL Shao.OQ3.uniform_standardized_pair_log_moment_approximation._proof_1_1
TYPE ∀ (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → m = 0 → False
AXIOMS [propext, Quot.sound]

DECL Shao.OQ3.pair_projection_moment_homogeneity
TYPE ∀ (law : MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (m : ℕ),
  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ m) law →
    ∀ (u v s : ℝ),
      have L := fun y => u * y 0 + v * y 1;
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => L y ^ m) law ∧
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => (s * u * y 0 + s * v * y 1) ^ m) law ∧
          ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), (s * u * y 0 + s * v * y 1) ^ m ∂law = s ^ m * ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), L y ^ m ∂law
AXIOMS [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
KIND theorem
